setup_xds_kubernetes_test: create a subclass of XdsKubernetesTestCase to set up gRPC XDS tests on Kubernetes with GCP Traffic Director
assert_successful_rpcs: test that all RPCs succeed by sending requests and verifying every backend received at least one RPC
assert_failed_rpcs: test that all RPCs fail by sending requests and verifying the expected number of failures
setup_security_policies: build mTLS or TLS security policies for client and server using Traffic Director secure manager
assert_test_app_security: review the security mode of connected client and server sockets to verify mTLS, TLS, or plaintext
